sections.heading: 1. Why Reproduction
points: **Reproduction** = the production of new individuals of a species — it ensures the **continuation of the species**.
It also passes on **traits** to the next generation (via **DNA/genes**); small variations aid **evolution and survival**.
Two modes: **asexual** (one parent) and **sexual** (two parents).

sections.heading: 2. Asexual Reproduction
points: Involves a **single parent**; offspring are **genetically identical** (clones).

sub: **Vegetative propagation** — new plants from roots/stems/leaves/buds (potato, Bryophyllum).

sections.heading: 3. Sexual Reproduction
points: Involves **two parents** and the **fusion of male and female gametes** → offspring show **variation**.
In **flowering plants:** stamen (male, pollen) and pistil (female, ovule); **pollination → fertilisation → seed & fruit**.
**Human reproductive system:** **male** — testes (make **sperm** + testosterone); **female** — ovaries (make **eggs** + oestrogen), uterus.
**Fertilisation** (fusion of sperm and egg) → zygote → embryo develops in the **uterus**.

sections.heading: 4. Reproductive Health
points: **Puberty** brings the ability to reproduce; **menstruation** is a normal cycle.
**Contraception / family planning** methods space or prevent pregnancy.
Awareness of **STIs (e.g. HIV/AIDS)** and reproductive health is important.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Reproduction continues the species & passes on traits (DNA); variation aids evolution.
Asexual (one parent, clones): fission (Amoeba), budding (Hydra/yeast), fragmentation (Spirogyra), regeneration (Planaria), spores (Rhizopus), vegetative propagation.
Sexual (two parents, variation): gamete fusion.
Human: testes → sperm + testosterone; ovaries → eggs + oestrogen; fertilisation → zygote in uterus.
Contraception = family planning; awareness of STIs (HIV/AIDS).

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Asexual** reproduction gives **identical (clone)** offspring; **sexual** gives **variation**.
**Fission = Amoeba; budding = Hydra/yeast; fragmentation = Spirogyra; regeneration = Planaria; spores = Rhizopus.**
**Testes make sperm; ovaries make eggs**; fertilisation forms the **zygote**.
Variation from sexual reproduction is the **raw material of evolution**.
